title: An evidence-guided reinforcement learning method to improve psychiatric reasoning in small language models
abstract: arXiv:2602.06449v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Privacy and computational constraints limit the use of large language models in psychiatry, while adapting small language models (SLMs) often requires substantial data and expert annotation. We developed ClinMPO, an evidence-guided reinforcement-learning framework guided by the psychiatrist-defined Clinical Psychiatry Thinking Strategy (CPTS). ClinMPO uses ClinRM, a reward model trained on 18,569 question--answer pairs from 4,474 psychiatry articles. We evaluated four Qwen3 sizes on 1,737 model-screened questions. ClinMPO outperformed Base, supervised fine-tuning and standard group relative policy optimization across scales. From responses by 300 senior pre-licensure medical students, we established the human baseline, a medical-student reference. translated_title: 一种证据引导的强化学习方法，用于提升小型语言模型的精神病学推理能力
translated_abstract: 隐私和计算资源限制制约了大型语言模型在精神病学领域的应用，而适配小型语言模型（SLMs）通常需要大量数据和专家标注。我们开发了ClinMPO，这是一个由精神科医生定义的临床精神病学思维策略（CPTS）指导的证据引导强化学习框架。ClinMPO使用ClinRM作为奖励模型，该模型基于来自4,474篇精神病学文章的18,569个问答对训练而成。我们在1,737个经模型筛选的问题上评估了四种规模的Qwen3模型。结果显示，ClinMPO在各模型规模上都优于基础模型、监督微调和标准的组相对策略优化方法。基于300名高年级执业前医学生的回答，我们建立了人类基线（即医学生参考标准）。4B模型接近这一基线，而8B模型则超越了它，并在31个模型及后训练变体中排名第一。ClinMPO在两个互补的……上均提升了性能。
tldr: ClinMPO是一种由精神科医生定义的思维策略指导的证据引导强化学习框架，仅使用少量数据即可让小型语言模型在精神病学推理上达到甚至超越医学生水平，其中8B模型在31个模型中排名第一。
en_tdlr: ClinMPO, an evidence-guided reinforcement learning framework built on psychiatrist-defined clinical thinking strategies, enables small language models to match or exceed the medical-student baseline in psychiatric reasoning, with the 8B model ranking first among 31 models.
